caption: The drawing depicts a single metal object that appears to be an andiron or a similar fireplace implement. The drawing is rendered in shades of gray and black on a plain, off-white background, using pencil or graphite, and focuses on careful shading and contour lines to indicate the three-dimensional form and metallic texture of the object.
